core_obligations: Reduce low-degree operator positivity to a smooth spectral-function estimate.
Derandomize the estimate and establish the explicit running time and promise correctness.
difficulty_reason: Uses matrix invariance and derandomization to reduce a Fourier-specified exponential-dimensional positivity problem to a deterministic test with explicit degree/local-dimension/error dependence. The positivity-testing promise and complete algorithm/correctness proof are retained as a principal standalone tool.

dedup.scope: Root checked complete legacy, aliases, preparation and both active lines for exclusive DOI without neighbors. Supporting smoothing, hybrid, truncation and answer-reduction lemmas and direct consequences are uncounted.
